title: Parallel Hearts
author: spqceyz00mer
summary:
In another universe, the stars still shine- but they don't feel the same.
Rose Tyler once travelled all of time and space with a man who could burn suns and rewrite history. Now, she lives a quieter life in a parallel world, with a different version of him, and a daughter who looks at the stars like they're calling her name.
Because they are.

But some stories never really end.
And some wolves... never stop running.

title: Castle of Glass
author: Laurawrzz
summary:
‘We’ll be okay,’ she suddenly said in the quiet.The Doctor didn’t answer.‘You’ll find a way,’ she insisted. ‘You always do.’For a moment he said nothing, his eyes still fixed on that middle distance. ‘… What if I don’t this time?’ he croaked.
The Eternal Goddess of Life has been tortured into pieces, and only the Doctor’s family may be able to put her back together.
But the machine that destroyed Life nearly broke the Doctor beyond repair, leaving him permanently scarred in body and mind, while Lanwa left Rose trapped in the aftermath of a body used to enslave, mutilate and kill innocent people. He no longer knows whether he can save anyone. She no longer always feels that her body belongs to her.
At the Eternals’ request, the Doctor and his family must cross a universe bereft of life with no plan and no way home, gathering the scattered fragments before the consequences reach every living thing in the real universe.

summary:
Detective Inspector Peter Carlisle is called to Blackpool to investigate a suspicious death, when a young man's body is discovered in the bins behind Ripley Holden's new arcade. Ripley reeks of guilt, but Carlisle must prove he dealt the fatal blow, and the arcade owner won't give up easily. From witty repartee, their relationship develops a darker side, with Ripley seeking to establish control over the smart-mouthed detective; lines are crossed and emotions run high as things become intense between them.
Meanwhile, the Tardis delivers the Doctor, Jack, Aziraphale, Crowley, and Zee to Blackpool, 2004, in response to Zee's childhood nostalgia. Meeting another doppelganger barely feels like a surprise, and they set out to get to know this new lookalike, who displays a remarkable level of skill in ice-cream licking.
As Ripley's life begins to fall apart, Carlisle finds himself caught between his duty as a police officer, his magnetic attraction to the dominating arcade owner, and the exciting freedom he sees in the polyamorous lives of his new friends.
And for some reason, everyone keeps bursting into song...

title: Angel Famine
author: haleinedelail
warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
summary:
Four months after the events of "Partnership," the Doctor and Martha are trying, bless them, to have a date night.  But it all goes awry when they realize a hotel in Kensington has apparently purchased a statue of an angel that appears to be weeping, as lobby decor.
Naturally, there have been a string of disappearances since the angel showed up, but there's something decidedly odd about the pattern of disappearance.  Like, who gets zapped, and how often?  And if people are disappearing from the hotel lobby, it means the angel is feeding... so why does the angel appear to be starving?
With the help of a new friend, a slightly socially stunted man named Sanjesh (he has his reasons for being a weirdo), they will learn what's behind the angel famine.  The answer has to do with social injustice, particle physics, and a terrorism plot.  As a side-effect, the Weeping Angel could get hold of a device with the potential to give it god-like powers!
How will they juggle all of it??
*Rated T, except for chapter 10, which is more of an M.

summary:
"You can run you know."
The comment was spoken so softly that Izuku wasn't sure he'd heard it right at first.
With a tentative blink, the boy turned his face towards the man who stood, facing outward towards the battle, his eyes drawn into a dark thought as he hummed low.
"You're not obligated to stay. You never were."
And the boy faltered for a moment, halted by the comment and the...rejection the man presented him. The out.
"You can leave."
You can run, he was saying. Escape. Be free. He didn't need to got through this war, this pain, this loss. Not again.
Aizawa-Sensei...was trying to spare him?
And yet...
Izuku...the boy... The Doctor only shook his head and rubbed at his nose as he sniffled. His fingers trembled, but his shoulders remained firm.
"I said I'd save them all. I said I'd rescue her. And I will." He remarked softly, his voice quavering. "And I've never been called a liar."
"But you are a hero," All Might's voice chimed to his left.
And no. That wasn't right. Izuku shook his head to disagree. He'd never been a hero.
"No," He retorted. "Not that. It's because I'm The Doctor."

summary:
The fact of the matter is that you are a doctor, now.
You don’t need the universe. You don’t need the Doctor. You just need the people here on earth.
You don’t need to fix the Doctor, and you don’t need the Doctor to fix you.
You are not second fiddle to the Doctor, or Rose Tyler, or any of the rest.
But you deserve to have all of that, don’t you think? You deserve to have someone who treats you like the stars. You deserve to have someone who looks at you like you aren’t a second place, a silver medal to another girl’s golden hair, but as if you are the universe. 
You’ve seen emptiness. You’ve seen the end of all things.
And you are going to burn out someday, you know, but it won’t be on the TARDIS. It won’t be because you were overlooked. It will be because you burned bright as can be, helping other people, doing what you could to save the world, but also because you let yourself live your own life.

title: Do You Believe Me Now?
author: spqceyz00mer
summary:
They found her on a church doorstep in the snow.
No past. No answers. Just a name- Ruby Sunday.
Now, she has a life full of music, laughter, and a family she chose. Travelling with The Doctor has shown her the universe- endless, beautiful, and dangerous all at once.
But something isn't right.
There are moments Ruby can't explain.
Snow that falls when it shouldn't.
Strangers who look at her like they already know her.
A quiet, creeping feeling that something is coming- something only she can see.
She tries to ignore it.
Because every time she gets close to the truth, the world seems to fall silent.
And no one else hears the warning.
But Ruby does.
And this time... she's going to make them listen.

title: A House Of Stone, An Ivy Grown
author: spqceyz00mer
summary:
In every corner of time, she exists.
A governess in Victorian London.
A voice trapped in a machine.
A soldier, a queen, a child staring at the stars.
58 lives, scattered like fragments across the universe- each one making the same impossible choice.
To stay.
To fight.
To save someone else.
But in one life Clara Oswald begins to break the pattern.
Grieving a love she cannot replace, and drawn back into a life she knows will destroy her, she steps once more into the path of the Doctor- into something dangerous, consuming, and impossible to escape.
Because this time, the story is different.
This time, the echoes don't just die.
They remember.
And as past and future begin to blur, as lives start to overlap and choices begin to repeat, Clara will come face to face with the truth of who she is- not just one girl, but all of them.
And she will have to decide: Is she the girl who always dies? Or the one who finally chooses something else?

title: Heart of a Dragon
author: drautumn123
tags: Not Ten bashing but definitely Nine-centric
summary:
Since his regeneration, things have been off between the Doctor and Rose. She keeps trying to convince herself that he's the same person, but her grief for her lost Doctor insists that they aren't. He managed so many miracles that despite how his regeneration should have been one more, she is still waiting. She doesn’t deserve it— she killed him— but still. She waits.
The Doctor doesn’t know how to convince her that he’s the same person, when he isn’t sure that he is himself. He feels disconnected from his ninth self in a way he never has before, unsure where it leaves him, or his relationship with Rose.
When an adventure goes wrong, Rose is abducted by a dragon, who makes no secret he intends to keep her. She feels an immediate connection to him (once she figures out that he isn’t going to eat her, of course). Beneath his prickly hide, he's sweet and sad, and reminds her so much of the Time Lord she still loves, and can’t let go of. Their bond grows as they ease each other’s grief.
Rose is torn between the three of them, her love for the TARDIS, and her ever worsening grief, as the gulf between her and the Doctor widens. Will they regain their common ground? How is Bad Wolf working in the background?

title: Keeping Our Forever
author: drautumn123
summary:
With their newly established Bond in place and the TARDIS healed, the Doctor, Rose, and Jack are finally ready to dive back into the universe, though the threatening futures Rose saw as Bad Wolf are still lingering over their heads. Rose and the Doctor must come to terms with what exactly the Wolf has done by trapping the Doctor in his current regeneration, while Rose battles guilt and grief at having done so against her relief at not losing her Doctor (and the horror that she might still, if Bad Wolf's warnings aren't properly heeded). Jack begins to feel the strain of his missing memories once again, and being the perpetual third wheel to the intensity of their relationship, and as always, the TARDIS meddles as she sees fit in the lives of her occupants.
Season 2 rewrite beginning with New Earth.

title: They Can't Take What's Ours
author: spqceyz00mer
summary:
The universe is vast, unpredictable, and never kind to things that shine.
For The Doctor, time has always been something to run through- never something to hold onto. But when he meets Rose Tyler, everything changes. Suddenly, the endless expanse of space feels smaller. Brighter. Almost like home.
Their story isn't told in order.
It can't be.
Instead, it unfolds in fragments: stolen moments in the TARDIS, laughter echoing across distant planets, quiet moments that feel too fragile to last, and memories that don't quite line up the way they should. A beginning that feels like an ending. A goodbye that comes too soon- and yet, somehow, not soon enough.
Because time has a way of bending around them.
Of repeating.
Of breaking.
And no matter where, or when, they find each other, the same truth remains: he chooses her.
Again. And again. And again.
But the universe has always had rules.
And this love was never meant to last.

To her surprise after a moment his features cleared and a faint look of bewilderment settled on them; he pulled at his coat again and she realised he had started to shiver, fingers shaking as they tried to grip the fabric. “Doctor, are you all right?”
“I don’t know… it’s a bit…. bit cold, isn’t it?” His voice was suddenly trembling too, and he shook his head as if trying to clear it. “Funny… I hadn’t – hadn’t noticed before…”
“He’s not all right.” Hastily sobering Alex caught hold of his grandfather’s arm as the older man staggered and his eyes widened in shock. “Cass, he’s freezing!”

“Oh, no, that’s what we’re here for!” the Doctor interrupted. “The conference. We’re on the guest list. Look.” He proffered his psychic paper. “See?”
Peering at the psychic paper, the manager took on a look of mild disdain. “Oh – oh, I see,” he said. “I thought you lot had all arrived already. This unit will check you in – once you have your room assignment, proceed to the atrium to pick up your dossiers and press passes.”
“Press passes?” said the Doctor, perking up in obvious excitement. “Are we the press?” He glanced at the psychic paper. “Right! Yes! We’re the press. That’s us.” Leaning in, he dropped his voice and said, “Sniff Scoop – Stellar Bugle."

title: The Girl Who Waited, Out Of Time
author: spqceyz00mer
summary:
Amelia Pond has lived her life out of order.
She remembers things that haven't happened yet.
Forgets things that mean everything.
Loves people at the wrong time- and sometimes, not enough when it matters most.
In a quiet, shifting place that feels like her childhood home Amy finds herself surrounded by cracks in the walls. Each one pulses with a memory: a moment of fire and frost, of love and loss, of a life lived alongside a man who never stayed... and the one who always did.
As songs echo through the fractures, Amy is pulled through the most defining moments of her life- her endless waiting, her reckless running, her complicated love for the Doctor, and the quiet, unwavering love of Rory Williams.
But something is wrong.
The memories don't line up.
Rory disappears where he shouldn't.
The Doctor arrives too late- or too early.
And the cracks are getting wider.
Because this isn't just Amy remembering.
This is Amy being forgotten.
And if she can't piece her life back together then the girl who waited will become the girl who was erased.

In 1963, Doctor Who first arrived on the airwaves of Britain and would become one of the longest lasting science-fiction TV series. Yet, here a fanciful "what-if" is asked.
What if Doctor Who had been brought to the United States around the same time as it started in the U.K.? Could it gain a foothold in the U.S.? Could U.S. Public Television history be changed?

summary:
"Pity, Doctor. You know, I tried to keep the gloves on for you, but I've realized how fun it is too get my hands dirty," he says. "You really should just listen to your Master."
The Master places a two-fingered salute to his lips and mimes a kiss before placing both of his hands against the Doctor's forehead.
"Contact," the Master says, pressing more than his fingers into the Doctor's skull. His mind is ablaze as he fans the fire into the Doctor's consciousness.
"Contact," the Doctor responds, unable to resist. It never could, even when it was a he.
A swift current of force torrents itself into the Doctor's mind. It crashes against the Doctor's poor mental shielding as the Doctor's thoughts collapse like an avalanche. From above, a flood of sensation that's not the Doctor's own rains down like the harshest blizzard, pushing it's way through the Doctor's attempts to defend itself. Each second, thoughts pound into the Doctor like painful hailstones, and the Doctor is buried in the cold.

The break of dawn always comes like a breath of fresh air. Cool at first, like the dampness of the dew that rests on blades of grass; but the warmth of the rising sun quickly permeates what sat dormant overnight, bringing it to life. The golden glow of the sun that peeks over the horizon blazes light years away, but it somehow comes from within. 
 
  That’s what it feels like. The same cycle. It happens over and over again, yet the awe never eludes them. Every time that fire burns within them, it’s a new beginning, a new opportunity.

title: I Like Me Better When I'm With You
author: kernow_wordsmith
characters: Rose Noble (Doctor Who: The Star Beast)
summary:
There he stood, his smile wide and lighting up his entire face. His hair was windswept, mussed from his helmet, and he'd already unzipped his jacket down to the centre of his chest. "Excuse me," he said, his voice soft and teasing as he leaned against the doorframe. "I'm looking for a Ms. Lethbridge-Stewart."
She wound her hands into the leather and gently pulled Christofer through the entry into her home and towards her. "You found her," she replied, before raising herself up onto the balls of her feet and pressing her lips to his.

They both sighed into the kiss, Christofer shutting the door behind him and winding his arm around her waist, his hand settling on her lower back. It felt good, to have him in her private space, separated from work; like he was always supposed to be there.

It felt right.

--

A series of moments exploring the development and progression of the relationship between Kate Lethbridge-Stewart and Christofer Ibrahim. Set between The Power of the Doctor (2022) and Empire of Death (2024).

title: [Podfic] Coming Back Together

summary:
Rose has wandered far and wide.  She's seen many things, done many more, run with the Storm and on her own feet, leaped through worlds and ensured the stars would not go out.
And now she has to learn to live with her Doctor, her real and true Doctor.  One advantage?  He's settled down at St. Luke's, guarding a vault, so they have time to work things out without being in (as much) life-threatening danger.

What is that subtle headache?The one that won't go?The absolute horror of not being able to tell yourself how it all goes wrong?
How does one earn forgiveness from the Doctor? The very man who killed his own kind to a win a war? The man who would go to any length to save the ones he loved? The one that burnt a whole star just to say goodbye.How do you come back from hurting someone close to him?---You wake up one day, finding yourself outside your old childhood home. You recognise the place, vaguely remembering all the ways you had messed up your very own life.And it's not long before you start to realise that you aren't where you were just a day ago, no.In fact you're not even living in the same year.You're back to the series of fateful days that first started your downfall. A twisted game from the cosmos. And you have to change it.To save yourself, you must cease to exist.And this was exactly the Doctor's plan. A paradox.A choice.Because you can't change anything, god no. That would tear the universe in two. So you must either watch yourself fall apart over and over and over again, or, you can decide to let it all fall apart.

summary: The truth was, she prided herself on her ability to recall memories like they were pristine photographs, and so it irritated her no end that she couldn’t remember most of the details of the invasion last week. summary: En ce lundi 30 juin 2014, l'Entrepôt 13 est sur le point de basculer dans une crise sans précédent. Artie Nielsen découvre qu'un certain Jonathan Edgar Carlson a forcé les systèmes ultra-sécurisés du Pentagone pour retrouver la trace d'un mystérieux sorcier immortel répondant au nom de Thaddeus Marlowe. Averti par Madame Frédéric que le temps des secrets est révolu, Artie envoie Myka et Pete sécuriser Jonathan, ignorant que l'Entrepôt est déjà infiltré par Soren Malvek et ses agents.Au Pentagone, Holly Marten et Ravi Chakrabarti, deux anciens de l'UNIT mandatés par Shonna Bennett, tentent de s'infiltrer sous de fausses identités pour libérer Jonathan avant qu'il ne tombe dans un piège. Ils se retrouvent rapidement face à Myka et Pete, contraints de révéler leur véritable identité et leur connaissance de Marlowe.Dans l'ombre du Secteur 4, Claudia et Steve découvrent que Parrish n'est autre que Marlowe lui-même, qui orchestre tout depuis le début avec Benedict Valda. Alors que les quatre agents s'engouffrent dans un ascenseur pour atteindre Jonathan, Marlowe active son labyrinthe et les précipite dans ses entrailles, hors du temps et hors du Pentagone.

Behind him, Jack hears a light footfall and the swish of petticoats. —Damn, he still doesn’t even know her name.
He doesn’t give her the satisfaction of seeing pain from him. Instead, he meets her gaze head-on, cool and distant and every inch the soldier.
She laughs at him. It’s a high-pitched giggle, like the joke is genuinely hilarious, and he’s simply missing out. It’s disconcerting: if there really is humour here, he is certainly on the outside of it.

The shop turned out to be Rose’s workplace, and it was there that Lilly met the man who would change their lives forever.

Why now? Yaz wants to ask. Why would you give me hope? Why not in China? Why not in Manchester? 
The Doctor takes a step forwards, reaching. Yaz steps back. “I came back.”
And it’s almost broken; it’s almost sorrowful. And Yaz nearly breaks; nearly jumps into her arms and clings to her, like she’s wanted to do for years now.
(And, in the back of her mind, fierce in its intensity—Why do you only ever want me when it’s too late?)
Then, the Doctor’s expression goes blank; unreadable. Yaz can see her—stacking those walls sky high; retreating and fleeing and shutting down and she laughs.
Nothing’s changed.

title: Take Me Back to the Start
author: tens_girl
characters: Whickber Street Shopkeepers and Street Traders Association (Good Omens)
tags: The main five characters are an established polycule
I'm not tagging all the relationships
But so much better with 51st Century sex toys!
summary:
Following the ill-fated holiday in Broadchurch, Zee finally engages a therapist to help her work through the lingering trauma of her time with Kilgrave. In particular, she hopes to rebuild the fulfilling sexual relationships she had before, but that will take time and effort, and her new therapist Doctor Scott encourages her to begin from the foundations to build upwards; going back to the start and viewing her relationships through the new perspective she has now, rather than simply yearning for what she once had. Step by step, she finds her way back, proving a handful for her therapist along the way.
Zee is not the only one impacted by the trauma of interactions with the mind-controlling doppelganger though, and her friends and partners find themselves exploring new angles in their relationships with each other too, with fresh dynamics emerging, and lots of new experiences.
Ultimately, love and friendship is what holds them all together. And as they celebrate Aziraphale's birthday, Christmas, and later Zee's birthday, there is enough fun, romance, and joy to heal them all.
Lots of fluff and smut, a dash of angst, and typical Who Omens shenanigans!

title: Ministry of Space: 2025
author: Amanda Girard (Amanda_Girard)
fandoms: The Man In The High Castle
summary:
Twenty-four years after the blackmail crisis of 2001, Britain still controls the oldest and most extensive space empire in human history, but the system is fraying. Its orbital power grid is failing, its Mars generation wants independence, the Americans and an Asian coalition have broken the British monopoly in cislunar space, and buried wartime crimes are now impossible to contain. A final constitutional struggle begins over whether the Ministry will reform into a commonwealth of worlds or drag the empire into civil and orbital war.
The story moves from exposure, to systems crisis, to public counter-administration. It begins with blackouts and leaks, escalates through attempted military and logistical coercion, and ends with the first rough constitutional mechanism capable of replacing imperial continuity with visible shared authority.
The series argues that empire survives less through flags than through logistics, forms, route priorities, supply control, and administrative language. It also argues that reform only becomes real when hidden procedures are dragged into public sequence and made answerable to mixed authority.

title: A Ghost In His Machine
author: Sammysammm
summary:
”Doctor!”
He froze.
Then, a smile pulled slowly at the corner of his mouth. A laugh followed, thin, barely audible, weak and disbelieving.
“Oh…That’s…That’s not fair.” The Doctor chuffed, turning to face the voice.
He blinked and rubbed his eyes. She was standing in the doorway of the TARDIS, wearing a pink zip-up hoodie, her hair parted cleanly down the middle. Her shadow loomed eagerly behind her, cascading across the TARDIS’ wall. Everything was right. Too right. Too real. It unnerved him, and he began to convince himself that it was just a hallucination, something the TARDIS was producing to calmly guide him to an inevitable darkness.
And yet? There she was, standing there like she always did when she was about to say something clever. Just as he predicted.

title: I Never Stood A Chance
author: WhyDoesItHurt
tags: So This Is Being Written Specifically Alongside Canon
To Give Me Free Reign to Practice Writing Scenery
But Canon Plays a Heavy Part
Because I Also Have Depression and Would Not Do This Without Rewards
summary:
"Save the Doctor."
The message on my phone was sudden, and random, and when I looked up, the TARDIS was right there. Appearing suddenly before the Doctor was strange, and the text was all that guided me.
No thoughts had to enter my head to let me do as I was told, for it was something many OC-inserts and Self-Inserts touched on--being his hero, instead of the reverse.
So I walked forward without a plan, without a thought in my head, and I instantly realized I didn't actually know how to communicate with anyone, let alone a nine hundred year old Time Lord whose entire life meant too much to me and mine.
I couldn't let him go, but how could I convince him to let me travel alongside him?

title: The Vale Diaries
author: Amanda Girard (Amanda_Girard)
summary:
"I’m an archivist. And it seems I’m going to the end of the world." - Dr. Elspeth Vale
Dr. Elspeth Vale is not your average historian; she is a forensic hunter of anomalous history. Her diaries chronicle a high-stakes global race against "The New Management," a shadowy corporate conglomerate obsessed with weaponizing "lost" media and optimizing the past into a sterile, profitable narrative.
From the neon-drenched spires of Tokyo—where a 1970s superhero suit became a living 6G antenna—to the crushing depths of Sydney Harbour, Vale uncovers artifacts that bridge the gap between media and physics. She navigates the "Mummy of the Reels" in Egypt, where mineralized Doctor Who film turned into a chemical bomb, and the "Singing Mask" of Athens, where ancient marble recorded the whispers of Cold War traitors. Vale’s journey reveals a terrifying truth: history is a volatile, entropic force.

It was a place for avid stargazers, and the natives had a yearly festival to celebrate when the stars were at their brightest, filled with dancing (and the infamous gelato). "I realized something," Yaz starts.

"Somewhere," Peri thinks aloud, "there's got to be a map." The thought comes slowly, the words slower. A few more corners, then she'll sleep. Once, she ran into the Doctor, very literally, eyes falling shut and not paying attention to the path in front of her. She'd asked him where his bedroom was and had ended the conversation unconvinced he slept at all. The Doctor had wrapped an arm around her shoulders and led her softly back. He'd changed so much since they'd first met. Every part of him replaced, growing into himself again, or a new version of himself. By comparison, Peri is so static.
"I fail to see what purpose that would serve," says the Rani, who doesn't exist.

title: La vagina de Hannibal Lecter
author: SAMMX
fandoms: ただいまおかえり | Tadaima Okaeri | Welcome Home (Manga)

summary:
Expresiones de horror erótico en el movimiento artístico fanart y fanfiction, o cuando serví coño en la facultad de Bellas Artes.
Una regurgitación del que fue mi TFG en bellas artes, tutorizado por Francisco Javier Gómez de Segura Hernández y María Begoña Martínez Pagán, a quienes siempre estaré agradecido. Aborda el desarrollo de un proyecto artístico que nace de la subcultura del fandom, apropiándome de los personajes de Hannibal NBC por Mads Mikkelsen y Hugh Dancy. Esta versión del ensayo, sin embargo, tiene un punto cómico que habría sido imposible defender ante el tribunal de la facultad sin acabar en suspenso. Hago cosas inconcebibles para el académico promedio, como hablar en primera persona y mencionar órganos sexuales mientras analizo las bases del fanart y el choque cultural entre fans angloparlantes e hispanohablantes, sin ser yo traductor ni nada de eso. Desde el apropiacionismo, que no plagio, desarrollo relatos de corte erótico y grotesco desde una perspectiva disidente del género y neurodivergente que resultan en una obra literaria, con ilustraciones que aúnan técnica de dibujo tradicional y técnica de color digital, encuadernada artesanalmente.

Yaz swallows roughly. It's like clockwork, this feeling; Yaz will remember, Yaz will imagine—the soft feel of her lips, the beautiful expanse of milky skin, going on for miles and miles. summary: Change is inevitable, immutable.  We cannot stop it, and often when we try, the effects spread faster than we can catch.  It's the little things that we barely see, the gravel in the tire pushed a little too deep, the raindrop in the pond spreading ripples to the other bank, the grain of sand in the lens, that we ignore.  But in the end, each builds, one upon the other, until finally the cuts are too much, until finally the scrapes and scratches are all that you can see.  And then you have to decide what is next? tags: Dubious Consent Due To Identity Issues
summary:
Lieutenant Surgeon Harry Sullivan is a good man. Competent, warm, dependable — the kind of officer who makes tea exactly the way his commanding officer likes it and never forgets a colleague's birthday. But beneath the affable exterior, Harry has recognised something in Brigadier Alistair Lethbridge-Stewart that no one else can see: a man slowly dying behind his own walls.
When Harry discovers an unguarded secret, a need the Brigadier cannot name, let alone fulfil, he makes a choice that will divide his life in two. In a shed at the bottom of a suburban garden, behind a hood and a voice modulator, he begins an anonymous arrangement designed to dismantle the most controlled man he's ever known. No names. No faces. Only trust, built in darkness, one session at a time.
But Harry is also falling in love, building a career, and living a life that has no room for what happens on Thursday nights. As the arrangement deepens and the Brigadier begins to transform in ways that reshape everything around him, Harry must confront the cost of what he's building, and the question of whether a thing done in secret, through deception, can still be an act of love.

summary:
“I wandered,” she said simply. “I often do. Sometimes I lose a shoe along the way.”
The Doctor let out a startled laugh. “Brilliant. Absolutely brilliant. You and me, we’re going to get on famously.” He leaned back against the console, eyes sparkling with mischief. “Tell me, Luna, do you want to wander a little further? Because this box doesn’t stop at mountains. It doesn’t even stop at planets. All of time, all of space, it’s right here.
Luna tilts her head again, hair tumbeling in a silver curtain. “All of time,” she echoed softly. “That sounds like quite a long walk.”
The Doctor’s grin softened into something more serious, almost reverent. “It is. But it’s worth it.”
She smiled then, dreamy and unhurried, as if she had already decided. “All right. I’ll come. Just don’t expect me to walk in a straight line.”

title: Thermal Acquisition
author: Lilahkat
summary:
Sarah Jane Smith has spent her life chasing the extraordinary through time and space. Kate Stewart arrives on her doorstep with nothing but a baby, a canvas bag, and a refusal to return to the life she was expected to live.
What begins as tactical—convenience, performance, a kiss to convince a watching world—slowly becomes something neither woman has language for. Between burnt lentils and borrowed blankets, between a father's silence and a child's first word, they build a life the law won't recognize and the world prefers not to see.
Some revolutions happen in kitchens. Some commitments require no officiant. And some people, once they've finally stopped running, discover they're capable of staying.A story about the radical act of being chosen—and choosing back.

Then he lost her. And now, he's left her behind. What right does he have, to keep this piece of her when he abandoned her, ran away like a coward without so much as a goodbye? What right does he have, to continue profiting from a miracle given to him out of a love he betrayed?

warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
summary:
Slowburn with a healthy dose of angst, whump, and smut.
Rose was months from freedom. After 10 years living a double life under a tyrant's thumb, all she had to do was outlast the contract that kept her trapped. She'd leave with nothing but her name, the only part of herself she'd managed to keep secret from the world, but she would be free. The only joy she'd been able to carve out for herself in those years was the rush of the fight, of screaming in unison with the masses, of momentum... It was the promise of freedom that kept her going. Wasn't it?
The crowd was all she knew. She was forever surrounded by the masses, and yet so alone.
The Doctor was adrift. He'd been adrift for years, searching for something. Anything. He'd been everywhere trying to find it, and he knew it was out there. He just didn't know what IT was. He'd devoted himself to medicine, and then traveling, and then the stars, and while he loved them all, something was still missing.
When the two of them meet in a crowd, both of them are immediately struck with the thought, "There you are." But as they fall together faster than the speed of gravity, will they be able to hold on?

title: Smith & Sullivan: The Hollowing
author: Anonymous
warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
summary:
Smith and Sullivan, the Lost and Redacted files. Found and decoded.Sarah Jane Smith, Freelance journalist.Harry Sullivan, Medical OfficerBoth previous Companions of 'The Doctor'.
Files logs:
It's 1986, and Sarah Jane Smith hasn't heard from Harry Sullivan in months. Not since a Christmas card that arrived three days late. So when the phone rings at half eleven on a Tuesday night and Harry's voice comes through shaking, she knows something is very wrong.
Harry's been stationed at a secret research facility in the Norfolk fens. Buried deep beneath the chalk, his team unearthed something ancient — a living alien organism sealed in the earth for seventy million years. Now it's awake. Now it's feeding. One by one, the people around him are being hollowed out. Their memories, their personalities, everything that makes them them, quietly consumed and replaced by something empty and networked and patient.
Harry's next. He can feel it happening. And he can't leave. Sarah Jane drives through the night to pull her oldest friend back from the edge of oblivion; before there's nothing left of him to save.

The events of School Reunion dredge up many of Rose’s inner demons. Her dreams haunt her that night as she imagines the man she loves treating her like she was worthless. What awaits her after her dream? What is Madame de Pompadour really like and why is she in danger? Rose deals with some of her deepest insecurities while facing the reality of how women are perceived and treated throughout history.
The Doctor is rattled by the reality that Rose's lifespan is just a blip for him, but he must learn not to let his own fears of intimacy hurt Rose.
Meanwhile, Mickey is struggling with his own feelings of inadequacy. He wants to be so much more than just the tin dog but he's thrust into an era with even more prejudice than his own, making matters worse.

White light and smoke filled the entrance as 6 white-suited figures stepped into the room. The Doctor closed her eyes, wishing for all of this to stop and to wake up from this nightmare. 
 
  The first figure untinted her visor, showing blonde hair and red lipstick. "Hello, sweetie," she said, a smug smile curling the corners of her lips.

title: Brotherhood
author: Iescape
summary:
Brotherhood is a two-part fantasy about two immortal brothers, Waltheri and Baldor, who reincarnate as human infants-stripped of their memories-until reaching the age they were once frozen at: 22 and 26. And why reincarnations? I got inspired mostly by Doctor Who in this aspect-I just loved the idea that I could explore many eras with the characters.
And this time, Waltheri was born in modern-day Prague as Lukas, and Baldor in Helsinki as Cyrill. They are hybrids of many creatures as they were reborn in many families that were not always human.
In Part 1, Waltheri's awakening fails, leaving him vulnerable, unaware of incoming threats. The story is opened by Mia, Waltheri's flatmate, who narrates both the beginning and the end of the story.
In Part 2, the brothers face new challenges. It's about family, y'all and all the angst you can get. What unfolds is a journey of forgiveness, memory, and belonging, as a found family begins to take shape across lifetimes.

title: Turns Into Other Parts
author: TheQueenHasNoLife
summary: One of the most curious things about the TARDIS. It is a machine, metal, and science welded together. Parts of it are alive. That's undeniable. It breathes and whines. It can be afraid; a coward sometimes, just like the man who stole it. The most fascinating thing about it, more than anything, is to be haunted within ‌its walls. The TARDIS its own place outside of reality and existence. Those plain walls on the outside. Leading to a nearly endless network of hallways, doorways, spaces, and almost cracks in reality. Not really cracks, but windows. Glimpses. A shimmer of light and focus. As it turns into other parts. It is a fascinating thing to be haunted by the ghosts of the future. It's something that The Doctor knows well.

title: What a monstrous idea, Doctor
author: Yoyodiza
summary:
Time isn't good or bad.
But Time also created fixed points; fixed points that can never been changed. Even if it ends in death.
After a mission ends in fire and silence, Yaz barely survives, carrying the ghost of a child she could not save.
The Doctor saves her, heals her, stays by her side.
But at what cost?
Grief turns into anger, and anger into a reckoning neither she nor the Doctor can avoid. When the truth of fixed points is finally spoken aloud, Yaz refuses to accept a universe that demands children as currency.
Time may be neutral.But Yaz isn’t.
And the Doctor is no longer sure she ever was.

title: Just Sarah Now
author: Lilahkat
summary:
After the Doctor leaves her behind in School Reunion, Sarah Jane Smith does not break.
She chooses.
She leaves London. She packs the artifacts of a life spent in orbit around impossible things. She takes K-9 and crosses an ocean—not toward another adventure, but toward something smaller, braver, and entirely her own: a life where she can stop being Sarah Jane and simply be Sarah.
In Sunnydale, she finds a librarian who stays. A handful of teenagers who need a home. A rhythm that doesn’t depend on catastrophe to give it meaning. She writes. She questions. She builds. And, for the first time, she allows herself to be wanted.

title: OPRAVDOVÁ TEMNOTA
author: OliverJasansky
summary:
Praha. Filipojakubská noc. Parta teenagerů vleze do sklepení bývalého kostela jen kvůli „debilní zábavě“… a otevře něco, co se nemělo ani škrábnout nehtem.
Ve stejnou dobu ve Stockholmu zmizí Codex Gigas, Ďáblova bible. A na jejích stránkách nejsou jen obrázky a pověsti, ale zaklínadla, která umí ovládat démony a měnit realitu. Všechno do sebe začne zapadat způsobem, ze kterého je na zvracení i bytostem, které běžně pijí krev a říkají tomu práce.
Do Prahy doslova spadne Doctor i se zlobící TARDIS, která se vypíná, protože realita je náhle slepená dohromady jako... chiméra.
Charlie Bradburyová se objeví jako hologram a zkouší udržet aspoň nějaký plán, zatímco Winchesterové letí přes bouři do místa, kde podle všeho začíná první bitva.
Jenže tady nejde jen o jednu knihu a jedno město. Do ulic se tlačí temnota, pekelné intriky, čarodějnice, duchové… a něco, co nemá patřit do žádného světa, protože existuje jen proto, aby je všechny zlomilo.A uprostřed toho se nachází obyčejná holka, která se stane Osou celé Chiméry.
Když se světy prolínají, nevyhraje ten nejsilnější. Vyhraje ten, kdo přijde na to, o čem to celé vlastně je… dřív, než Praha zhasne.

summary:
Our story begins as The Doctor finds himself in London in a beautiful new body, ready to take it for a spin on the dance floor when he comes across Simon, not his real name, a human who has been masquerading as The Doctor for two years. Not feeling quite himself just yet, the Doctor decides to take the time to see where this mess is headed. After a trip to UNIT with the fake, he learns that the man not only has a touch of Time Lord energy, just like The Doctor has a touch of mascara, but there's something familiar about him.
Also, his new body has a few kinks to work out, and energy to burn...
Simon only ever took up The Doctor's mantle in the hopes of meeting... not him. He wanted to meet the previous version, and finds this one to be a disappointment. But after two years of work, making a comfortable new life for himself in this London, as a beloved figure in this universe, what is he supposed to do now? Go home? To what? To where? As who? A Swedish exchange student, sitting at home on his couch with his cat? Moving once was hard enough, and Simon hates travel.
This story takes place more than 2 years after the events of Doctor Who episode 319b The Reality War.

title: I’m falling down, below the ground, please show me the way
author: thesilentscriptora
fandoms: The War Between the Land and the Sea (TV)
warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
summary:
“It’s a nice place you’ve got yourself,” the Doctor says.
He stands with his hands buried deep in the pockets of his coat, shoulders drawn in, facing the glass as though the skyline might offer him an escape route. His reflection hovers faintly over the city, fractured by rain. For a moment, he doesn’t look like the Doctor at all—just a man lingering where he isn’t wanted.
Then, as if remembering himself, he turns slowly. His eyes find hers, and whatever lightness he’d been wearing slips, leaving something raw and unguarded behind. “Katie,” he says softly. “I’m so sorry.”
“Don’t call me that,” Kate hisses. The words are sharp, immediate, her arms folding across her chest as though she can physically keep herself from coming apart. “I thought it would be your older version,” she continues, voice trembling despite her effort to keep it steady. “But I suppose he’s too carefree now to notice.”

author: aletterinthenameofsanity
warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
summary:
Every companion’s room disappeared the moment that they left the TARDIS, save Rose’s.
The Doctor has been keeping it around as a sort of memorial. A ghost of a girl that had radically knocked his life off of its path, reminding him of the worth of cowardice and kindness, and then drove them both down the path towards their own destruction as they made each other more self-destructive than ever.
The TARDIS went to erase it after Donna got into the TARDIS, at the possibility of a new companion, but it didn’t work out, because the Doctor clung with bitter, aching, bleeding fingertips to that room. To the life that had once lived in it, no matter how impossible it would be for Rose to return.
But then came Dr. Martha Jones.
It is impossible to ignore the way that Rose Tyler existed as a ghost throughout their entire relationship, the echo of a girl that was gone but not dead, too much to be left behind, too much to continue.
(There is a ghost over Martha and the Doctor's relationship that makes it hard for the Doctor to see her for who she truly is, but someday, the truth just might come through.)

summary:
Yaz used to worship the Gods. Used to pray to them every night, burn food at an altar while asking them for help. Except help never came, and her village was burned to the ground, and she died while pleading, begging, praying, for help.
Except she didn’t. She didn’t die. She lived and then kept on living, far longer than any other human. Yaz couldn’t die. The Gods had spat in her face when she’d asked for her help and cursed her to outlive anyone she might come to love. And she couldn’t even kill herself to take the pain away because they’d taken her ability to die away as well.
Yaz is just trying to live a normal in London when she’s hauled back into the world of Gods, Goddess, and now, apparently, the end of the fucking world.

When Ryan decided to move out to the Netherlands a few months ago, Yaz thought he was mad. He neither spoke Dutch nor was he able to ride a bike – his dyspraxia prevailed despite Graham’s attempts to teach him – not to mention the fact he hated trying new foods. This had all been taken into account and conversations had been had but, in the end, the new social media job proved too good an opportunity to miss out on.
That’s why Yaz was now sitting at 30,000 feet, two hours into the six and a half hour flight. The journey had been fairly smooth so far, just a small delay from Sheffield to Manchester airport thanks to the holiday traffic. The take-off had been good too, although Yaz had only been out of the country twice before this and so her experience was limited to be fair.

summary:
When eleven-year-old Celestia Temple grows up moving through foster homes and being quietly overlooked, she learns how to survive by becoming a shadow—someone the world looks through instead of at. Her one constant is Rose Tyler, the bright, stubborn young woman assigned to her through a Big Sister program. Rose sees her. Rose stays. And for Celestia, that is enough.
Until the night Henrik’s explodes.
When Rose vanishes in the aftermath, Celestia’s carefully small world fractures. Guided by a strange, unnameable pull, she races across London to find her—only to collide with a mysterious stranger called the Doctor. A stranger who notices her immediately. A stranger who looks at her like she matters.
Swept into a universe of living plastic, alien threats, and impossible wonders, Celestia begins to question the one thing she’s always believed about herself. Her ability to go unnoticed may not be accidental—and the shadows she’s hidden in may be hiding things from her in return.
Celestia is done being invisible.

Liana was part of that number, however, before her conversion could be completed, the Cybermen were defeated, leaving her behind in the conversion theatre. She was eventually found and rescued by UNIT, and her remaining injuries treated. Her conversion could not be reversed because 90% of her body was already cybernetic, only leaving her face, most of her head, her neck and the upper portion of her chest organic. On the other hand, her emotional inhibitor remained disabled. That said, she never got connected to the Cybermen’s shared knowledge and neural network. Retaining her humanity and memories, but knowing she couldn’t go back to her ordinary life due to her now being a monster, she started to travel throughout the galaxy on her own until she ran into the Doctor, who took her under his wing as a companion. title: They Make Love All Night

summary:
This piece is the unpacking of that one line at the end of the scene in Give Me Time with the Doctor and Rose's reconciliation. In the story, that line felt right, a curtain drawn on their healing. But after I wrote that scene, I kept turning that sentence in my mind, and eventually I came to the conclusion that I had to write it out in full.
This is a strange piece, and not only for the choice of the external narrator. They come into it utterly raw and naked, so unrecognizable I second-guessed putting the character/relationship tags at all. Ultimately, I think it's a sign of how deeply that story broke them.
But, they're fine now ❤️

“So what’s that bit, then?”
“The stabiliser.” He tapped the housing, careful and precise. “Looks simple enough, but it’s the trickiest piece in here. Keeps the time rotor from throwing us into a wall. All it takes is one slip and–” He mimed an explosion with his free hand.
She tilted her head, studying the little gear and catch. “So it’s delicate.”
“Delicate,” he agreed. “Always drifting out of line. Got to keep the right hold, constant correction, otherwise…” He trailed off, words catching in his throat. Otherwise everything falls apart.

title: It's only love

warnings: Creator Chose Not To Use Archive Warnings
tags: what if i said shes also kind of a sugar mommy
summary:
You could still feel the breeze tugging at your hair, the sun heating your bare shoulders, like it hadn’t been six whole months since you’d stood there shaking hands with the older blonde in the lazy summer dress and bored expression that you had previously only seen (and pined for) from afar.
What had once seemed like an easy solution to your desire to be part of this world—agreeing to become Kate Stewart’s companion, no, her girlfriend, her partner, her lover, turned out to demand far more of you than you had ever imagined.
Because the moment Kate’s arm curled around your hips and her lips flirted over the line of your jaw in a warm breath and loudly murmured, “I have exactly what I wanted right here!” you felt your heart rush dangerously toward the edge of heartbreak.

summary:
The man known as “John Smith” clicks the watch open. Golden light swirls through the air, coming right for him, going through him. He screams, his body on fire, what feels like every single cell burning, his blood boiling, and right before what should be the peak of the pain – it stops. His blood turns from boiling to sluggish ice.
He looks at his empty hand and blinks at it. He had – he had a watch.
“Whoops,” someone says. He raises his head. There’s a woman in front of him. She feels incongruous. An apparition that shouldn’t be here.
She feels familiar. He’s never seen her before.
She has his watch in her hand. It’s closed. “A tiny bit rude of me,” she adds, sounding apologetic. “But it’ll be interesting. I promise.” She chuckles. “At least for me.”

title: The Long Way Around The Stars

summary:
The universe has a taste for mischief and misplaced travelers. When a man who calls himself the Doctor falls out of the sky and lands on a sand-scorched world, SG-1 expects problems—alien tech, rogue Goa’uld, maybe a buried artifact or two. They do not expect someone who hears the Stargate hum like a memory, or a man whose past feels older than the dunes beneath their boots.
When a robed figure steps through the Gate speaking a language that settles uncomfortably into the mind, the Doctor’s cheerful façade fractures, revealing something ancient, exhausted, and far too familiar with the technology SG-1 thought they understood.
As the team tries to unravel who this stranger is and why the Gate answered him, the Doctor is forced to confront echoes of a life he left behind. A confrontation in the desert becomes the spark that pulls SG-1 into a larger, far older conflict—one that refuses to stay buried.
A story of improbable allies, buried histories, strange harmonics, and the truth no one is prepared to face.

“Rose…” The word scraped its way out of his throat, raw and broken. “Rose, I can’t-”
“Colour,” she interrupted gently, but there was urgency in her tone. “What’s your colour?”
Oh. Oh… oh he was so stupid. The embarrassment burned through his veins, stung his eyes with brimming tears, and he thrashed his head from one side to the other, lashes fluttering against the velvet of the blindfold.
“Y-yellow.” He whispered, and almost instantly there was a warm hand on his bare chest, over his singular heart. His breath hitched, and he flexed his wrists instinctively, seeking her touch. The restraints held firm, biting into him again. He whimpered softly. “No, no, no, hold on, hold on… Thorns.”
*****

title: this will pass
author: kathkin
summary:
His left forearm looked unhurt. He didn’t want to know. But he had to know. He had to see. Very slowly, in a futile last-ditch attempt to delay the inevitable, he lifted it and inspected the underside.
There were two varga thorns snagged on his shirt.
With shaky fingers, he tugged one of them out. There was a twinge of pain and at that moment his breath left him. He yanked out the second thorn and briskly rolled up his sleeve.
He counted one, two – three puncture wounds – already upraised and red and warm to the touch. There were more shed varga thorns on the ground.
Alright, so this might be bad. This might be very, very bad.

“There was a girl,” she said. “From a nowhere place. Didn’t matter to anyone but herself. She got lucky one day — met someone who showed her the stars. Thought that meant she mattered. Thought she could do something big.”
Her throat tightened. She pushed through it.

It was one of those dreadful, sinking moments, as the pieces came together inside his head. And to his absolute mortification, by how big Vicki’s eyes were getting she was having the exact same realisation at the exact same moment.
She said, “Are you –”
“No,” he said, frantically waving for her to shut up. “No, no –”
“You are!” she hissed, jabbing a finger at him. “You’re in rut.”
He held up his hands and said, “No I’m not.”
“No, you are.” A smile was spreading across her face. She was, evidently, taking some degree of schadenfreude in his situation, and he might actually scream. “You’re in rut.”
Like every civilised, twenty-fourth century alpha, Steven gets a suppressant shot every three months and has no intention of going into rut until he's in a loving, committed relationship. Unfortunately, all of his life plans were spectacularly derailed when he crash landed on Mechanus and now he might be having his first rut. In the late twentieth century. At least a hundred years before suppressant medication was invented.

summary:
When the Daleks set their sights on the Doctor, the Doctor makes an unthinkable choice. Using the Chameleon Arch, he erases every trace of his Time Lord identity, locking away centuries of memories, knowledge, and power in a small fob watch. In his place is left a human baby - ordinary, and utterly unaware of who he truly is.
On a quiet night, Lily and James Potter stumble upon that baby in a bundle alone in the street beside a strange blue box. Unable to have children of their own, they take him in, naming him Harry James Potter. But the wizarding world has its own dangers, and a prophecy soon entwines "Harry" in yet another war, but this one he was never meant to have to fight. Voldemort comes, the Potters fall, and the boy survives. Alone. Again.
A somewhat cracky Harry Potter AU where magic meets time travel, and where the Boy Who Lived is much, much bigger on the inside.

summary:
“But I’m not like them.  I’m not afraid to die.  I cannot die, not as you would understand death,” you insist, though we know it isn’t true.
“But you can flux, wither, and change your state.  That is a sort of death.”  I would know better than most.  I remember the crude plastic apparatus penetrating one of my hearts, the anesthesia filling me up and making the world spin and go dark, the opera ringing in my ears, Madame Butterfly.  I remember waking up in the dark and the cold with no idea where or who I was.  And though each is as real as the other, the memory of dying on the operating table does not belong to me any more than the memory of waking up a newborn in an unfamiliar world belongs to him.
So, as I said earlier, I am not talking (or thinking) to myself, even if I am talking to ourselves.  The caterpillar and the butterfly are two distinct entities.  It’s only that I thought I was the butterfly, until you came along.
~
The Doctor and Zagreus talk to themselves.
